task: Allow an unallocated unfinished split to be split again while retaining completed sibling group PO allocations
specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); user reported S4 blocked by allocations belonging to S1/S3
acceptance: A PO allocation linked to a completed sibling delivery group, even when sales_order_ref identifies the root SO, must not block resplitting the selected unallocated child.
The source child remains subject to its own PO/TO allocation, packing, execution, plan and lease checks; initial root splitting still rejects root allocations.
Split numbering uses the original family and includes existing/retired/native-only siblings.
An authenticated HTTP resplit request succeeds and preserves sibling allocations, history, quantities and photos.
Rejected requests do not retire the source or create children; retry remains idempotent.
SOA09140 S1 and S3 PO allocations and S4's 4588 SQFT remain unchanged during deployment.

setup.dependencies: No new dependencies; reuse existing isolated Compose, Node tests, fast-check, c8, TypeScript and ESLint.
setup.tests: Disposable bounded containers in mbbs-tests.slice; teardown registered before starting; verify docker ps and ps -a plus task networks/volumes.
setup.release: Capture live source, patch only the selected-source argument in resplit numbering, test, deploy over the current image, retain rollback.
setup.git: Preserve unrelated workspace changes; no commit or reset.
setup.liveVerification: Read-only checks of allocation targets, split preview, numbering and unchanged quantities; do not execute an actual S4 split without quantities supplied by the user.
